phases.name: Start of Round
phases.summary: In Rounds 2-5, discard the three leftmost face-up Main Orders, slide the remaining two left and refill the display to five; refill Tech displays and ready once-per-round abilities.

phases.name: Work Phase
phases.summary: Players alternate placing one worker and resolving that shared location until all have passed. Printed spaces are global; a Shifu may overfill a fully occupied action location. A worker may be placed only if it can perform at least one instance of that location's main action.

phases.name: Firing Phase
phases.summary: If either Shared or Imperial Kiln contains ceramics, resolve Test Pieces, secret Contributions (including secret Fuel Ledger commitments), Base Heat, each Kiln Yard Shifu's previously marked ceramic in First Player order, Fire, Actual Heat, Kiln abilities, Quality, player-ordered after-Quality Techs and the optional 2-Coin discard of one still-Flawed ceramic per player.

phases.name: Order Phase
phases.summary: In reverse turn order, each opportunity completes at most one held or face-up Order or passes. Continue until a full circuit has no completion. Each Crown advances Imperial Recognition by one.

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.summary: Return workers and discard held Orders down to the limit of 3. If the round was not the fifth, pass First Player clockwise and advance the round.
